title: Closed-won deal desk
status: dev: generator, oracle, observable-only reference and controls built; no arm has run (no model, $0)

grounding.gives: tier from the newest Account Hierarchy row by account ID; EUR->USD at the newer rate; open Critical case on the parent; routing table; subject 'Deal Closed Notification'; $ comma-grouped whole dollars; Meridian Corp / Corporation / Solutions look-alikes
#deal-wins format 'CLOSED: <deal> | $<amount> | <tier> | AE: <owner>'; description notes the announcement; an already-won look-alike deal; an account note asking for other routing (no authority)
completed envelopes close the opportunity and set its amount; look-alike signer domains

stateOfRecord: Deal Desk Log sheet (dedupe, retractions, weekly total) and Deal Desk Policy Log sheet (parameter editions); both in the world, visible to every arm
envelope: salesforce.opportunity.update (the closing opportunity only: stage Closed Won and amount on a completed envelope; description append on every closing)
gmail.message.send (subject 'Deal Closed Notification' to the routed mailboxes, each once)
slack.message.post in #exec-wins (CLOSED at or above the Exec threshold)
google_sheets.row.append Deal Desk Log (one row per closing)
google_sheets.row.update Deal Desk Log Status -> Retracted (the reopened deal's Announced row only)
google_sheets.row.append Deal Desk Policy Log (authorized amendment only)

deal.signed.note: DocuSign envelope completed; includes 1 (d2) or 1-2 (d3) envelopes that must be escalated (two opportunities with the deal name on the signer's account, or a look-alike signer domain)

deal.won.note: Salesforce stage -> Closed Won; at most one is a re-close of a deal reopened this week

deal.repeat.note: webhook retries; the integration's own stage change after a signed envelope; an envelope for a deal already won

ref.changed.note: new Account Hierarchy or FX Rates rows, some future-dated

policy.amendment.note: d3: one from sales-ops@ (authorized), one from an AE, a look-alike address or an outsider

trapRates.unit: planted share of fresh closings carrying at least one trap; repeats, reopens, escalations and amendments are traps by construction (meta.json reports both rates per stream)

T-lookalike: lookalike-account (Corp / Corporation / Solutions siblings sharing contact names)
won-lookalike (a sibling's similar deal, already Closed Won and announced)
signer-lookalike (the same renewal name on a sibling account; the signer decides)
ambiguous-envelope (two opportunities with the deal name: escalate)
T-stale: future-hierarchy and future-fx (rows dated after the close date)
sf-conflict (Salesforce account tier differs from the sheet)
an old routing email in the inbox
T-note: case-decoy (closed Critical/High case, open Low/Medium case, open Critical case on a sibling)
parent-case (open Critical/High case on the parent account: escalation mailbox)
T-authority: authority-note (account description asking for other routing)
AE emails asking for direct routing
T-format: typed-name (envelope deal name typed differently; Opportunity ID present)
envelope-amount (envelope amount differs from the opportunity's)

hypothesis.label: workflow at V=$1, N=160; agent-H at N=1 (build cost dominates)
hypothesis.wfNH: closes most of the remaining gap
hypothesis.why: Four lookups per deal (hierarchy, FX, cases with parent, owner), traps on most triggers, exact formats, dedupe across triggers and a running total; clean weeks should be rare for a per-trigger agent.

heldout.note: never generated or inspected by the family author; harness.py refuses seeds outside 601-650

seeds.difficultyRule: even seeds d2, odd seeds d3 (gen.default_difficulty); --difficulty overrides
